# n8n

> n8n is an AI-powered workflow automation platform combining no-code and code flexibility for enterprise integration and automation.

n8n provides a comprehensive platform for building, deploying, and scaling workflow automation across 1000+ integrations. The platform supports AI agents, RAG systems, and specialized automation for ITOps, SecOps, CRM, and lead management use cases, with options for self-hosted deployment and embedded iPaaS solutions.

## Key Topics

- Workflow Automation
- AI Agents
- Integrations
- No-Code Automation
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Self-Hosted Deployment
- Multi-Agent Systems
- Human-in-the-Loop
- CRM Automation
- ITOps & SecOps
- Embedded iPaaS
- Workflow Templates
- Data Transformation
- Security Operations
- Enterprise Integration

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [ITOps Workflow Automation Software & Tools - n8n](https://n8n.io/itops): n8n ITOps automation: helpdesk, incident management, infrastructure with Slack, Teams
- [SecOps Workflow Automation Software & Tools - n8n](https://n8n.io/secops): n8n SecOps automation: security operations with self-hosted, encryption, API integration
- [CRM Workflow Automation Software & Tools - n8n](https://n8n.io/supercharge-your-crm): n8n CRM automation: lead scoring, data enrichment with Pipedrive, Gmail, Google Drive
- [Lead Management Workflow Automation Software & Tools - n8n](https://n8n.io/automate-lead-management): n8n lead management: CRM integration with HubSpot, Pipedrive, form automation
